summary: Goal Module - Complete testing done. All backend API tests (17/17) passed. All frontend pages (Dashboard widget, My Goals, Create Goal, Goal Detail, Edit Goal) verified and working correctly.

issues: Minor console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - This is a React hydration warning from the dropdown options. Low priority, functional impact is minimal.

seed_data_creation: Test goals created and cleaned up during pytest (TEST_ prefixed). 4 production goals exist: House Down Payment, Pay off Car Loan, 6 Month Emergency Fund (₹50K manual progress), Kids Education Fund.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Goal Module fully tested and verified working. Existing test goals in DB can be used for future testing.

my_goals_page.details: Summary shows overall progress (1.3%), 4 active goals, 0 completed. Filter tabs (All/Active/Completed) work. Goal cards show progress bars, priority badges, days remaining.

create_goal_page.details: 5 goal type options visible (Wealth Creation, Debt Elimination, Investment Target, Emergency Fund, Other). Goal name, target amount with amount-in-words, target date picker, priority selector, link sources section, manual override toggle all working.

goal_detail_page.details: Shows progress visualization (current ₹50K / target ₹3L = 16.7%), target date (30 Jun 2026), time remaining (135 days), smart suggestions (₹55.6K per month needed), Edit/Mark Complete buttons.

edit_goal_page.details: Pre-fills goal data correctly, shows Delete and Update Goal buttons. Edit flow works end-to-end.

dashboard_goals_widget.details: Shows '4 active goals' count, displays top 2 goals with progress bars (House Down Payment 0%, 6 Month Emergency Fund 17%), '+2 more goals' indicator.

goal_linking.details: Debt Elimination shows Link Loan and Link Credit Card dropdowns. Wealth Creation shows Link Investments and Link Accounts checkboxes with existing data (HDFC Flexi Cap Fund, SBI FD 2026, etc.).

backend_api.details: All 17 pytest tests passed: POST /api/goals creates goal, GET /api/goals returns goals with progress, GET /api/goals/:id returns detail, PUT /api/goals/:id updates, PATCH /api/goals/:id/progress updates progress, PATCH /api/goals/:id/complete marks complete, DELETE /api/goals/:id deletes, GET /api/goals/summary/dashboard returns widget data.
